Real Estate Brokers, Sales Persons and Rental Location Agents
Duties of Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons

law.catch_line: Compensation shall not imply brokerage relationship
law.text: The payment or promise of payment or compensation to a real estate broker does not create a brokerage relationship between any broker, seller, landlord, buyer or tenant.
